description: Two absolute paths with fWide=0, encoded in Windows-1252
notes: fWide=0 means the array is in the source machine's ANSI code page, which the payload does not record. 0xDF and 0xFC appear in the names. Path::to_string_lossy returns None here by design; with the `codepage` feature and an encoding the caller names, Path::to_string_with decodes. Read as CP437 the same bytes give different names, which is the failure a default guess would ship.
